title: Hot pot restaurant in Milpitas
assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: Articles of Organization (California LLC)
items.feeNote: Fee not read on an official page in this pass (registry says $70).
items.note: SF guide: LLCs "must register their structure with the CA Secretary of State before registering locally."

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Seller's permit
items.agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
items.note: "Every location must have this permit to sell taxable goods." Also on the LA restaurant checklist.

items.name: Employer payroll tax account registration (DE 1)
items.note: Register within 15 days of paying more than $100 in wages in a calendar quarter.

items.name: Food safety (manager) certification, at least one owner or employee
items.agency: Local environmental health agency (California Health and Safety Code 113947.1)
items.note: Within 60 days of opening; valid 5 years.

items.name: California Food Handler Card for food employees
items.agency: Local environmental health agency (California Health and Safety Code 113948)
items.note: Within 30 days of hire; valid 3 years; food managers exempt.

items.name: Fictitious Business Name statement
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.

items.name: Food facility plan check
items.agency: County of Santa Clara Department of Environmental Health
items.note: SJ Streamlined Restaurant Program: County DEH plans "ideally approved" before the city building application.

items.name: Health permit to operate a food facility
items.agency: County of Santa Clara Department of Environmental Health
items.note: San José's business tax registration asks for the "county health permit number, if applicable"; the county issues it.
items.match: (health permit|permit to operate).*(santa clara)|(santa clara).*(health permit|permit to operate)

items.name: Business license
items.quote: The Building and Planning departments will review and approve application.
items.note: Commercial applications are reviewed by Building and Planning; fee set by the Finance Department.

items.name: Building permit for the tenant improvement
items.agency: City of Milpitas Building Safety and Housing
items.quote: Approved drawings by the Santa Clara Environmental Health Department as required prior to permit issuance

order.why: IRS: "form your entity through the secretary of state before you apply for an EIN."
County plan approval before construction; the permit at the final inspection.
County-approved drawings before the city issues the permit.
